title: Breakout
summary: Multi-system composition — a Ball, a BrickField, and the game that owns them.
teaches: Orchestrator flow · lives & levels · clear/lose branching
controls: A/D or ←/→ move · SPACE launch/next/replay · P pause

machines.title: Breakout — the orchestrator
machines.blurb: The top-level game. It owns a Ball and a BrickField and never lets the driver touch them directly — it routes collision events inward, updates score / lives / level, and decides when a round is cleared or lost. Paused is pushed onto the state stack so resume returns exactly where you left off.

machines.title: Ball
machines.blurb: The ball's three modes: attached to the paddle, in flight, or lost off the bottom. Velocity is a state variable that exists only while InFlight — so every launch is a fresh serve with no stale velocity. After a miss the Ball self-attaches via a 2-second tick so the player sees the loss.
